'''Armed conflicts and attacks''' 
*[[Insurgency in Cabo Delgado]]
**[[2021 Cabo Delgado offensive]]
***The [[European Center for Constitutional and Human Rights]] (ECCHR) accuses [[France|French]] energy and petroleum company [[TotalEnergies]] of committing [[war crimes]] through a [[joint task force]] deployed to protect [[natural gas]] sites in [[Cabo Delgado Province|Cabo Delgado]], [[Mozambique]]. The ECCHR alleges that the joint task force illegally imprisoned, beat, tortured, and killed over 220 civilians. [https://www.dw.com/en/totalenergies-complicit-in-mozambique-war-crimes-ngo/a-74788904 (DW)]
*[[Palestinian political violence]]
**[[2025 Gush Etzion Junction attack]]
***At least three people are killed, including both perpetrators, and three others are injured, including a woman mistakenly shot by [[IDF|soldiers]], in a [[vehicle-ramming attack]] and [[stabbing attack]] in [[Gush Etzion Junction]], [[West Bank]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog-november-18-2025/?utm_source=article_hpsidebar&utm_medium=desktop_site&utm_campaign=liveblog_entry (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://www.cnn.com/2025/11/18/middleeast/west-bank-vehicle-ramming-attack-intl (CNN)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Kharkiv strikes (2022–present)|Kharkiv strikes]]
***A 17-year-old girl is killed, and nine other people are injured in overnight [[Russia]]n [[missile]] strikes on [[Berestyn]], [[Kharkiv Oblast]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://newsukraine.rbc.ua/news/russian-missile-strike-hits-kharkiv-s-berestyn-1763427414.html (RBC-Ukraine)]
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023-present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Gaza war]]

[https://www.newarab.com/news/13-people-killed-israeli-strike-lebanons-sidon-ministry?amp (MENA via ''The New Arab'')]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Austria]]n painter [[Gustav Klimt]]'s ''[[Portrait of Elisabeth Lederer]]'' sells for US$236.4 million ({{Euro}}203.2 million) at a [[Sotheby's]] [[art auction|auction]] in [[New York City]], breaking the record for the most expensive [[modern art]] piece. [https://apnews.com/article/golden-toilet-cattelan-auction-sothebys-ef4c0b1ccb2841c078ff59756fe6d7b2 (AP)] [https://www.theguardian.com/artanddesign/2025/nov/19/gustav-klimt-portrait-sells-for-2364m-making-it-the-second-most-expensive-artwork-sold-at-auction (''The Guardian'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*The [[United Kingdom]] announces it will ban [[Market manipulation|above-face-value]] [[ticket resale]] for [[concert]]s, shows, and sports events, citing rampant [[price gouging]] on [[primary ticket outlet|ticket sale sites]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/uk-plans-ban-on-ticket-resale-touts-in-bot-buying-era/a-74791364 (DW)] [https://www.cnbc.com/2025/11/18/uk-government-ticket-resale-ban.html (CNBC)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Saudi Arabia–United States relations]]
**[[Saudi Arabia]] and the [[United States]] ratify a joint declaration on civil [[Nuclear power|nuclear energy]], and the U.S. approves a [[Foreign Military Sales|defense sale]] that includes future deliveries of [[Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II|F-35]] [[Fighter aircraft|fighter jets]] to Saudi Arabia. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/us-saudi-arabia-approve-nuclear-deal-f-35-fighter-jets-sale-9660288 (AFP via NDTV)]
**[[U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] announces the designation of [[Saudi Arabia]] as a [[major non-NATO ally]]. [https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/defence/trump-says-designating-saudi-arabia-major-non-nato-ally/articleshow/125424498.cms (AFP via ''The Economic Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Gaza Strip under Hamas]], [[Blockade of the Gaza Strip]]
**[[Hamas]] arrests a staff member of local [[water supply|water provider]], Abdul Salam Yassin Company, [[Water supply and sanitation in Palestine|supplying water]] to nearly half of the [[Gaza Strip]], causing the company to suspend its operations. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/gaza-water-provider-suspends-services-after-hamas-detains-staff-member-2025-11-18/ (Reuters)]
*[[Trial for the 2022–2023 Brazilian coup plot]]
**[[Brazil]]'s [[Supreme Federal Court]] sentences three [[Brazilian Army|army]] officers and a [[Federal Police of Brazil|federal police]] officer to 21–24 years in prison after finding them guilty of participating in a [[Assassination attempt|plot to kill]] then-[[President of Brazil|president]]-elect [[Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva]] and other officials to prevent [[Third inauguration of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva|the 2023 transfer of power]]. The court rules that the group helped plan the broader [[2022–2023 Brazilian coup plot|coup attempt]] linked to former president [[Jair Bolsonaro]], who was previously convicted in the same case. [https://www.barrons.com/news/brazil-court-hands-officers-up-to-24-years-for-plot-to-kill-lula-4d5b71c3 (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
*[[War on drugs]], [[Spain–United States relations]]
**The [[Spain|Spanish]] [[National Police Corps (Spain)|National Police Corps]], in coordination with the U.S. [[Drug Enforcement Administration]], dismantle a [[Jalisco New Generation Cartel]] logistics office in Spain, arresting 20 people, including two members of the [[Organized crime in Italy|Italian]] [[Camorra]] organization. [https://english.elpais.com/international/2025-11-18/authorities-dismantle-jalisco-new-generation-cartels-office-in-spain.html (''El País'')]
*An [[Argentina|Argentine]] [[Judiciary of Argentina|court]] orders the seizure of 20 properties owned by former [[President of Argentina|president]] [[Cristina Fernández de Kirchner]] and her family in connection with her [[Corruption in Argentina|fraud]] conviction involving public works contracts. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/argentina-court-orders-seizure-properties-linked-ex-president-fernandez-de-2025-11-19/ (Reuters)]
*[[Poland]] annuls former [[Ministry of Justice (Poland)|justice minister]] [[Zbigniew Ziobro]]'s diplomatic [[Polish passport|passport]] at the request of prosecutors, who seek his arrest on charges that include leading an [[Organized crime|organized criminal group]] and [[Corruption in Poland|misusing public funds]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/poland-annuls-passport-ex-justice-minister-wanted-by-prosecutors-2025-11-18/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Danish local elections]]
**[[Denmark]] holds local elections, with the ruling [[Social Democrats (Denmark)|Social Democrats]] suffering large losses, including the [[List of lord mayors of Copenhagen|mayoralty]] of [[Copenhagen]], which they had held since 1903. [https://www.politico.eu/article/danish-pm-mette-frederiksen-takes-responsibility-party-local-elections-debacle/ (Politico EU)]
* [[2025 Texas redistricting]]
** A [[United States]] [[United States district court|district court]] bars [[Texas]] from using a newly drawn [[United States House of Representatives|congressional]] map in [[2026 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas|next year's midterm elections]], ruling that it is likely an [[Constitution of the United States|unconstitutional]] racial [[gerrymander]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/11/18/politics/texas-redistricting-trump-court-ruling (CNN)]
*[[Terrorism in the United States]]
**[[Governor of Texas|Texas governor]] [[Greg Abbott]] declares the [[Muslim Brotherhood]] and [[Council on American–Islamic Relations|CAIR]] as [[List of designated terrorist groups|terrorist organizations]] and bans them from owning land in [[Texas]], United States. [https://www.cbsnews.com/texas/news/abbott-declares-cair-muslim-brotherhood-terrorist-organizations-bans-land-purchase/ (CBS News)]
*The [[Poland|Polish]] [[Sejm]] elects [[Włodzimierz Czarzasty]] as [[Marshal of the Sejm|Marshal]], replacing [[Szymon Hołownia]], who becomes [[Deputy Marshal of the Sejm|Deputy Marshal]]. [https://marszalek.sejm.pl/marszalek10.nsf/wydarzenia.xsp (Sejm <small>in Polish</small>)]

'''Science and technology'''
*A major [[internet outage|outage]] of [[Cloudflare]] causes global disruptions to numerous apps and websites. Cloudflare says the outage occurred after a [[configuration file]] designed to handle threat traffic malfunctioned and triggered a crash in its software handling traffic for its wider services. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c629pny4gl7o (BBC News)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2026 FIFA World Cup qualification]]
**In [[association football]], [[Curaçao national football team|Curaçao]] qualifies for the [[2026 FIFA World Cup]] after winning [[2026 FIFA World Cup qualification – CONCACAF third round#Group B|Group B of the third round]] of [[2026 FIFA World Cup qualification (CONCACAF)|CONCACAF qualifiers for the World Cup]]. In its first [[FIFA World Cup|World Cup]] appearance, [[Curaçao]] becomes the smallest nation by both population and area to qualify for the tournament. [https://news.az/news/haiti-return-to-world-cup-after-50-years-as-curacao-make-history-as-smallest-nation-to-qualify (''Azerbaijan'')]
